answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 63 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the crystal challenge, the orchard audit can replay the signal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3855 identities would post 2403 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
